        addr, pc = read_word(pc)
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: setVect    thread[{thread_id}], 0x{addr:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x09:
        var_id = data[pc]; pc += 1
        addr, pc = read_word(pc)
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: djnz       var[0x{var_id:02X}], 0x{addr:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x0A:
        op_byte = data[pc]; pc += 1
        var_a = data[pc]; pc += 1
        cond_code = op_byte & 0x07
        cond_str = cond_names.get(cond_code, f"?{cond_code}")
        
        if op_byte & 0x80:
            val, pc = read_word(pc)
            target, pc = read_word(pc)
            print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: condJmp    if var[0x{var_a:02X}] {cond_str} 0x{val:04X} ({signed_word(val)}) goto 0x{target:04X}")
        elif op_byte & 0x40:
            var_b = data[pc]; pc += 1
            target, pc = read_word(pc)
            print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: condJmp    if var[0x{var_a:02X}] {cond_str} var[0x{var_b:02X}] goto 0x{target:04X}")
        else:
            var_b = data[pc]; pc += 1
            target, pc = read_word(pc)
            print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: condJmp    if var[0x{var_a:02X}] {cond_str} var[0x{var_b:02X}] goto 0x{target:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x0B:
        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        pal_idx = val >> 8
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: setPalette 0x{val:04X} (palette={pal_idx})")
    
    elif opcode == 0x0C:
        typ = data[pc]; pc += 1
        first = data[pc]; pc += 1
        last = data[pc]; pc += 1
        type_str = reset_types.get(typ, f"?{typ}")
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: resetThread {type_str}, threads[{first}..{last}]")
    
    elif opcode == 0x0D:
        page = data[pc]; pc += 1
        if page == 0xFF:
            print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: selectVideoPage BACK_BUFFER (0xFF)")
        elif page == 0xFE:

        page_str = f"page[{page}]"

        if page == 0xFE: page_str = "FRONT_BUFFER"
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: fillVideoPage {page_str}, color={color}")

        src = data[pc]; pc += 1
        dst = data[pc]; pc += 1
        src_str = f"page[{src}]"
        dst_str = f"page[{dst}]"
        if src == 0xFF: src_str = "BACK_BUFFER"
        if dst == 0xFF: dst_str = "BACK_BUFFER"
        if src == 0xFE: src_str = "FRONT_BUFFER"
        if dst == 0xFE: dst_str = "FRONT_BUFFER"
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: copyVideoPage {src_str} -> {dst_str}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x10:
        page = data[pc]; pc += 1
        page_str = f"page[{page}]"
        if page == 0xFF: page_str = "BACK_BUFFER"
        if page == 0xFE: page_str = "FRONT_BUFFER"
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: blitFramebuffer {page_str}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x11:
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: killThread")
    
    elif opcode == 0x12:
        str_id, pc = read_word(pc)
        color = data[pc]; pc += 1
        x = data[pc]; pc += 1
        y = data[pc]; pc += 1
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: drawString stringId=0x{str_id:04X}, color={color}, x={x}, y={y}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x13:

        src = data[pc]; pc += 1
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: sub        var[0x{dst:02X}], var[0x{src:02X}]")
    
    elif opcode == 0x14:
        var_id = data[pc]; pc += 1
        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: and        var[0x{var_id:02X}], 0x{val:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x15:

        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: or         var[0x{var_id:02X}], 0x{val:04X}")

        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: shl        var[0x{var_id:02X}], {val}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x17:

        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        print(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: shr        var[0x{var_id:02X}], {val}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x18:

  - If bit 7 of op byte is set: compare with word constant (7 bytes total)
  - If bit 7 clear: compare with var[byte] (6 bytes total)
  - Condition bits 0-2: 0=EQ, 1=NE, 2=GT, 3=GE, 4=LT, 5=LE
- 0x0B: setPalette word  (3 bytes) - upper byte = palette index

  1746→	JP Z, _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
  1747→	LD (VM_PC), BC
  1748→	JP _after_PC_update
  1749→
  1750→INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_DJNZ:
  1751→
  1752→
  1753→	; ====  COND_JUMP instruction  ====
  1754→	CP A, 0Ah
  1755→	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_COND_JUMP
  1756→
  1757→	LD B, (XIX)		; uint8_t subopcode = fetch_byte();
  1758→	INC XIX
  1759→
  1760→	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t v = fetch_byte();
  1761→	INC XIX
  1762→	CALL _read_vm_var
  1763→	PUSH DE			; save b = read_vm_variable(v) on stack
  1764→
  1765→	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t c = fetch_byte();
  1766→	INC XIX
  1767→
  1768→	; Determine operand 'a' based on subopcode bits
  1769→	BIT 7, B
  1770→	JP Z, _condJmp_not_var
  1771→	; bit 7 set: a = read_vm_variable(c)
  1772→	CALL _read_vm_var	; A still has c; DE = vm_var[c]
  1773→	JP _condJmp_have_a
  1774→_condJmp_not_var:
  1775→	BIT 6, B
  1776→	JP Z, _condJmp_byte_literal
  1777→	; bit 6 set: a = (c << 8) | fetch_byte()  (16-bit immediate)
  1778→	LD D, A
  1779→	LD E, (XIX)		; fetch extra low byte
  1780→	INC XIX
  1781→	JP _condJmp_have_a
  1782→_condJmp_byte_literal:
  1783→	; neither bit set: a = c (zero-extended byte, per reference)
  1784→	LD E, A
  1785→	LD D, 0
  1786→_condJmp_have_a:
  1787→	; DE = a (RHS), (XSP) = b (LHS), B = subopcode
  1788→	POP HL			; HL = b (LHS)
  1789→
  1790→	; Save comparison type (subopcode & 7) before clobbering B
  1791→	LD A, B
  1792→	AND A, 7
  1793→	PUSH WA			; save comparison type on stack
  1794→
  1795→	; Fetch the jump target word (big-endian, always consumed)
  1796→	LD WA, (XIX)
  1797→	EX W, A			; byte-swap: bytecode is big-endian
  1798→	LD BC, WA		; BC = jump offset
  1799→	INC 2, XIX
  1800→
  1801→	; Restore comparison type
  1802→	POP WA			; A = comparison type
  1803→
  1804→	; Dispatch comparison: b (HL) vs a (DE)

python3 << 'PYEOF'
import struct
import sys

with open("/home/fsanches/devel/custom-kn5000-roms/anotherworld/src/resources/resource-0x15.bin", "rb") as f:
    data = f.read()

def read_byte(pc):
    return data[pc], pc + 1

def read_word(pc):
    val = (data[pc] << 8) | data[pc+1]
    return val, pc + 2

def signed_word(val):
    if val >= 0x8000:
        return val - 0x10000
    return val

cond_names = {0: "EQ", 1: "NE", 2: "GT", 3: "GE", 4: "LT", 5: "LE"}
reset_types = {0: "freeze", 1: "unfreeze", 2: "delete"}

# Known subroutine addresses for annotation
labels = {}

pc = 0
lines = []
while pc < len(data):
    start_pc = pc
    opcode = data[pc]
    pc += 1
    
    # VIDEO 0x80-0xFF
    if opcode & 0x80:
        offset_lo = data[pc]; pc += 1
        x_byte = data[pc]; pc += 1
        y_byte = data[pc]; pc += 1
        raw_offset = ((opcode << 8) | offset_lo)
        offset = raw_offset * 2
        note = ""
        if y_byte > 199:
            note = f"  [y>199: x_adj={x_byte + (y_byte-199)}, y_adj=199]"
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: VIDEO_0x80  offset=0x{offset:04X}  x={x_byte}  y={y_byte}{note}")
        continue
    
    # VIDEO 0x40-0x7F
    if opcode >= 0x40:
        offset_word, pc = read_word(pc)
        offset = offset_word * 2
        x_byte = data[pc]; pc += 1
        
        bit5 = (opcode >> 5) & 1
        bit4 = (opcode >> 4) & 1
        if bit5 == 0 and bit4 == 0:
            x_lo = data[pc]; pc += 1
            x_str = f"x=0x{(x_byte<<8)|x_lo:04X}"
        elif bit5 == 0 and bit4 == 1:
            x_str = f"x=var[0x{x_byte:02X}]"
        elif bit5 == 1 and bit4 == 0:
            x_str = f"x={x_byte}"
        else:
            x_str = f"x={x_byte + 0x100}"
        
        y_byte = data[pc]; pc += 1
        bit3 = (opcode >> 3) & 1
        bit2 = (opcode >> 2) & 1
        if bit3 == 0 and bit2 == 0:
            y_lo = data[pc]; pc += 1
            y_str = f"y=0x{(y_byte<<8)|y_lo:04X}"
        elif bit3 == 0 and bit2 == 1:
            y_str = f"y=var[0x{y_byte:02X}]"
        elif bit3 == 1 and bit2 == 0:
            y_str = f"y={y_byte}"
        else:
            y_str = f"y={y_byte}"
        
        zoom_bits = opcode & 0x03
        if zoom_bits == 0:
            zoom_str = "zoom=64"
        elif zoom_bits == 1:
            zoom_var = data[pc]; pc += 1
            zoom_str = f"zoom=var[0x{zoom_var:02X}]"
        elif zoom_bits == 2:
            zoom_val = data[pc]; pc += 1
            zoom_str = f"zoom={zoom_val}"
        else:
            zoom_str = "zoom=64,video2"
        
        video_src = "video2" if zoom_bits == 3 else "video1"
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: VIDEO_0x40  off=0x{offset:04X}  {x_str}  {y_str}  {zoom_str}")
        continue
    
    if opcode == 0x00:
        var_id = data[pc]; pc += 1
        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: movConst   var[0x{var_id:02X}], 0x{val:04X} ({signed_word(val)})")
    
    elif opcode == 0x01:
        dst = data[pc]; pc += 1
        src = data[pc]; pc += 1
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: mov        var[0x{dst:02X}], var[0x{src:02X}]")
    
    elif opcode == 0x02:
        dst = data[pc]; pc += 1
        src = data[pc]; pc += 1
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: add        var[0x{dst:02X}], var[0x{src:02X}]")
    
    elif opcode == 0x03:
        var_id = data[pc]; pc += 1
        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: addConst   var[0x{var_id:02X}], 0x{val:04X} ({signed_word(val)})")
    
    elif opcode == 0x04:
        addr, pc = read_word(pc)
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: call       0x{addr:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x05:
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: ret")
    
    elif opcode == 0x06:
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: pauseThread")
    
    elif opcode == 0x07:
        addr, pc = read_word(pc)
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: jmp        0x{addr:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x08:
        thread_id = data[pc]; pc += 1
        addr, pc = read_word(pc)
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: setVect    thread[{thread_id}], 0x{addr:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x09:
        var_id = data[pc]; pc += 1
        addr, pc = read_word(pc)
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: djnz       var[0x{var_id:02X}], 0x{addr:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x0A:
        op_byte = data[pc]; pc += 1
        var_a = data[pc]; pc += 1  # this is variable index for LHS (always read as variable)
        c_byte = data[pc]; pc += 1  # this is the 3rd byte
        
        cond_code = op_byte & 0x07
        cond_str = cond_names.get(cond_code, f"?{cond_code}")
        
        if op_byte & 0x80:
            # bit 7 set: RHS = var[c_byte]
            target, pc = read_word(pc)
            lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: condJmp    if var[0x{var_a:02X}] {cond_str} var[0x{c_byte:02X}] goto 0x{target:04X}")
        elif op_byte & 0x40:
            # bit 6 set: RHS = (c_byte << 8) | fetch_byte()  -- 16-bit immediate
            extra = data[pc]; pc += 1
            imm = (c_byte << 8) | extra
            target, pc = read_word(pc)
            lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: condJmp    if var[0x{var_a:02X}] {cond_str} 0x{imm:04X} ({signed_word(imm)}) goto 0x{target:04X}")
        else:
            # neither: RHS = c_byte (byte literal)
            target, pc = read_word(pc)
            lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: condJmp    if var[0x{var_a:02X}] {cond_str} {c_byte} goto 0x{target:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x0B:
        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        pal_idx = val >> 8
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: setPalette pal={pal_idx}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x0C:
        typ = data[pc]; pc += 1
        first = data[pc]; pc += 1
        last = data[pc]; pc += 1
        type_str = reset_types.get(typ, f"?{typ}")
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: resetThread {type_str}, threads[{first}..{last}]")
    
    elif opcode == 0x0D:
        page = data[pc]; pc += 1
        if page == 0xFF:
            lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: selectVideoPage BACK_BUFFER")
        elif page == 0xFE:
            lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: selectVideoPage FRONT_BUFFER")
        else:
            lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: selectVideoPage page[{page}]")
    
    elif opcode == 0x0E:
        page = data[pc]; pc += 1
        color = data[pc]; pc += 1
        pn = {0xFF: "BACK_BUF", 0xFE: "FRONT_BUF"}.get(page, f"page[{page}]")
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: fillVideoPage {pn}, color={color}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x0F:
        src = data[pc]; pc += 1
        dst = data[pc]; pc += 1
        s = {0xFF: "BACK_BUF", 0xFE: "FRONT_BUF"}.get(src, f"page[{src}]")
        d = {0xFF: "BACK_BUF", 0xFE: "FRONT_BUF"}.get(dst, f"page[{dst}]")
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: copyVideoPage {s} -> {d}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x10:
        page = data[pc]; pc += 1
        pn = {0xFF: "BACK_BUF", 0xFE: "FRONT_BUF"}.get(page, f"page[{page}]")
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: blitFramebuffer {pn}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x11:
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: killThread")
    
    elif opcode == 0x12:
        str_id, pc = read_word(pc)
        color = data[pc]; pc += 1
        x = data[pc]; pc += 1
        y = data[pc]; pc += 1
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: drawString id=0x{str_id:04X}, color={color}, x={x}, y={y}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x13:
        dst = data[pc]; pc += 1
        src = data[pc]; pc += 1
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: sub        var[0x{dst:02X}], var[0x{src:02X}]")
    
    elif opcode == 0x14:
        var_id = data[pc]; pc += 1
        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: and        var[0x{var_id:02X}], 0x{val:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x15:
        var_id = data[pc]; pc += 1
        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: or         var[0x{var_id:02X}], 0x{val:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x16:
        var_id = data[pc]; pc += 1
        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: shl        var[0x{var_id:02X}], {val}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x17:
        var_id = data[pc]; pc += 1
        val, pc = read_word(pc)
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: shr        var[0x{var_id:02X}], {val}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x18:
        res_id, pc = read_word(pc)
        freq, pc = read_word(pc)
        vol = data[pc]; pc += 1
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: playSound  res=0x{res_id:04X}, freq={freq}, vol={vol}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x19:
        part_id, pc = read_word(pc)
        if part_id >= 0x3E80:
            part_num = part_id - 0x3E80
            lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: LOAD       GAME_PART({part_num})")
        else:
            lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: LOAD       resId=0x{part_id:04X}")
    
    elif opcode == 0x1A:
        res_id, pc = read_word(pc)
        delay, pc = read_word(pc)
        pos = data[pc]; pc += 1
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: playMusic  res=0x{res_id:04X}, delay={delay}, pos={pos}")
    
    else:
        lines.append(f"  0x{start_pc:04X}: UNKNOWN    opcode=0x{opcode:02X}")

for line in lines:
    print(line)

## Corrected condJmp Encoding

An important note: the opcode description provided in the question has the condJmp bit assignments inverted relative to the actual implementation in `/home/fsanches/devel/custom-kn5000-roms/anotherworld/src/another_world_vm.asm` (lines 1768-1785). The correct encoding is:

- **Bit 7 set**: RHS is `var[byte]` (variable comparison, 6 bytes total)
- **Bit 6 set** (bit 7 clear): RHS is `(byte << 8) | fetch_byte()` (16-bit immediate, 7 bytes total)
- **Neither set**: RHS is `byte` (zero-extended byte literal, 6 bytes total)

## Overall Structure

### Thread Map

The bytecode uses the following threads:

| Thread | Address | Purpose |
|--------|---------|---------|
| 0 | 0x0000 | Main thread: entry point, splash screens, protection UI |
| 10 | 0x0D70 | "Correct answer" flag loop: sets var[0x31]=1 each frame |
| 14 | 0x0D62 | Copy protection screen to page[0], set palette 1 |
| 20 | 0x02CE | Code wheel protection check main logic |

| 44 | various | Palette fade animation (multiple entry points) |
| 50 | 0x0D41 | Sets var[0x67]=1 then kills self |
| 60 | 0x10A3/10B2/10C1 | Display loop: blit, copy, pause cycle |
| 63 | 0x0D46 | Sets var[0x67]=0 continuously |

### Entry Point (Thread 0, PC=0x0000)

```
0x0000: call       0x10D0          ; Initialize video pages (clear page[1], page[2], set blits)
0x0003: movConst   var[0xFF], 2    ; Frame delay = 2 (var[0xFF] is used by PAUSE)
0x0007: setVect    thread[60], 0x10A3  ; Start display loop
0x000B: pauseThread                 ; Wait one frame for display loop to start
0x000C: fillVideoPage page[0], 7   ; Fill drawing page with color 7
0x000F: setVect    thread[20], 0x02CE  ; Start the code wheel / protection logic
0x0013: killThread                  ; Kill thread 0 (logo splash is inline below)
```

The second `killThread` at 0x0014 is dead code (never reached).

0x0015: addConst   var[0x63], 1    ; These add constants to various vars
0x0019: addConst   var[0x5A], 13   ; This is the "code book" protection hash

0x0049: ret

## Logo/Credits Splash Screen Flow (Thread 0, starting at 0x007B)

This is the main splash screen sequence that plays when the game starts. It is **entered from thread 0** after thread 20 starts at the code wheel. Looking at how the flow works:

The thread 20 code at 0x02CE calls 0x004A (init), then enters the code wheel UI. But the code at 0x007B-0x01AC is only reached by `jmp 0x007F` from address 0x0D1B (after successful protection check) or via the initial var[0x54] check.

### Splash Screen 1 -- Bitmap Logo (0x007B-0x00BC)

```
0x007B: movConst   var[0x54], 0x0080 (128)    ; protection bypass marker
0x007F: condJmp    if var[0x54] LT 128 goto 0x00BF  ; skip to screen 2 if < 128
0x0085: fillVideoPage BACK_BUF, color=0
0x0088: setPalette pal=0
0x008B: LOAD       resId=0x0012                ; Load bitmap resource 0x12
0x008E: selectVideoPage page[0]

## Protection Verification (0x0C2A-0x0CB7)

This is the **actual code-wheel check**:

```
0x0C2A: setPalette pal=0
; Decode the expected answer by reversing the encoding:
0x0C2D: shr        var[0x38], 4      ; undo SHL 4 from 0x0393
0x0C31: condJmp    if var[0x29] NE var[0x38] goto 0x0D4F  ; FAIL if mismatch
0x0C37: shr        var[0x43], 3      ; undo SHL 3 from 0x039B
0x0C3B: condJmp    if var[0x2A] NE var[0x43] goto 0x0D4F  ; FAIL
0x0C41: shr        var[0x3A], 2      ; undo SHL 2 from 0x03A3
0x0C45: condJmp    if var[0x2B] NE var[0x3A] goto 0x0D4F  ; FAIL

; Check that answer symbols match the 4 user-entered values:
; Check var[0x29] against vars[0x1E..0x21]:
0x0C4B: condJmp    if var[0x29] EQ var[0x1E] goto 0x0C66
0x0C51: condJmp    if var[0x29] EQ var[0x1F] goto 0x0C66
0x0C57: condJmp    if var[0x29] EQ var[0x20] goto 0x0C66
0x0C5D: condJmp    if var[0x29] EQ var[0x21] goto 0x0C66
0x0C63: jmp        0x0D4F           ; FAIL - symbol not found in answer

; Same for var[0x2A]:
0x0C66-0x0C7E: Check var[0x2A] against vars[0x1E..0x21]
; Same for var[0x2B]:
0x0C81-0x0C99: Check var[0x2B] against vars[0x1E..0x21]
; Same for var[0x2C]:
0x0C9C-0x0CB4: Check var[0x2C] against vars[0x1E..0x21]
```

The protection works by:
1. The expected answer is encoded in `var[0x29..0x2C]` (the 3 symbols from the code book, plus an optional 4th)
2. These were encoded by shifting left (SHL 4, 3, 2, 1) and OR-ing with constants at 0x0393-0x03A7
3. Verification undoes the shifts (SHR 4, 3, 2) and compares
4. Then checks that each expected symbol appears somewhere in the 4 user-entered slots (vars 0x1E-0x21)
5. The check is unordered -- the player just needs to have entered the right 3-4 symbols in any order

### Success Path (0x0CB7-0x0D1B)

```
0x0CB7: call       0x0A15           ; Update hash
0x0CBA: setVect    thread[10], 0x0D70  ; Start "correct" flag (var[0x31]=1)
0x0CBE: setVect    thread[30], 0x0D78  ; Keep "waiting" flag
; First-time correct:
0x0CC2: condJmp    if var[0x31] EQ 1 goto 0x0CD7  ; already verified? skip
0x0CC8: movConst   var[0x31], 1
0x0CCC: mov        var[0xBC], var[0x37]  ; Save hash for state tracking
0x0CCF: or         var[0xBC], 0x0010
0x0CD3: jmp        0x02D1           ; Go back to redraw screen (second pass)

; Second-time correct (var[0x31] already 1):
0x0CD7: condJmp    if var[0x1B] NE 21 goto 0x0D4F  ; var[0x1B] must be 21
0x0CDD: and        var[0x32], 0x001F
0x0CE1: condJmp    if var[0x32] LT 6 goto 0x0D4F   ; need at least 6 correct bits
0x0CE7: condJmp    if var[0x64] LT 20 goto 0x0D4F  ; need at least 20 attempts?
; Success confirmed:
0x0CED-0x0D15: Various anti-tamper calls and state setup
0x0D18: call       0x0D22           ; Final anti-tamper chain
0x0D1B: jmp        0x007F           ; >>> GO TO SPLASH SCREENS <<<
```

After passing verification, the code jumps to `0x007F` which is the splash screen sequence, which ends with `LOAD GAME_PART(1)` at 0x01A9.

## Utility Subroutines

### 0x023D -- Symbol Lookup Table
Maps `var[0x05]` (position 0-15) to `var[0x06]` (symbol ID from vars[0x0A..0x19]). This is a 16-entry switch statement implementing an array access.

### 0x041A -- Draw Symbol by ID
Takes `var[0x05]` (symbol ID 0-31), draws the corresponding polygon from video1 at position `(var[0x2D], var[0x2E])`. Uses 32 different polygon offsets in video1 (0x0F64..0x13D0).

### 0x057B -- Clear Symbol Array
Sets vars[0x0A..0x19] and var[0x2C] all to 0.

### 0x0E49 -- Calculate Grid Position
Converts symbol index (var[0x05]) to screen coordinates (var[0x07], var[0x08]):
- `var[0x07] = (index & 7) * 40 + 20` (column, 40px spacing)
- `var[0x08] = (index & 8) ? 178 : 134` (top or bottom row)

### 0x0E7B -- Draw Symbol Glyph by Value
Large switch statement mapping symbol value (var[0x06]) to polygon offset in video1, drawing at (var[0x07], var[0x08]) with zoom from var[0x04]. Handles values 1-40, plus special values 98 and 99.

### 0x08CC / 0x096D -- Array Read/Write by Index
These implement indexed array access for vars[0x0A..0x19] using var[0x22] as index.

### 0x0A15 -- PRNG Hash Update
Adds multiple variables into var[0x37] to create a pseudo-random value used for symbol selection and anti-tamper checks.

### 0x0A37 -- Zero Check Validation
Checks that no code symbol (vars 0x0A..0x17) is zero. If any is zero, jumps to failure (0x0D4F).

### 0x0A7A -- Duplicate Check Validation
Checks that no adjacent code symbols are equal. If any duplicates found, jumps to failure (0x0D4F).

   - `0x0126`: string 0x0181, color 18, (80,2) -- Credits screen 1 line 1
   - `0x012C`: string 0x0182, color 15, (100,3) -- Credits screen 1 line 2
   - `0x014D`: string 0x0183, color 1, (80,4) -- Credits screen 2 line 1
   - `0x0153`: string 0x0184, color 20, (100,5) -- Credits screen 2 line 2
   - `0x0159`: string 0x0185, color 11, (120,6) -- Credits screen 2 line 3
   - `0x0180`: string 0x0186, color 14, (80,4) -- Credits screen 3 line 1 (conditional)
   - `0x0186`: string 0x0187, color 14, (100,6) -- Credits screen 3 line 2 (conditional)
   - `0x018C`: string 0x0188, color 14, (120,5) -- Credits screen 3 line 3 (conditional)
   - `0x02D9`: string 0x0144, color 4, (100,15) -- "ENTER CODE" prompt
   - `0x03DB`: string 0x0142, color 0, (50,8) -- Code wheel grid frame/box

2. **LOAD instructions** (opcode 0x19):
   - `0x008B`: LOAD resId=0x0012 -- Bitmap screen (Delphine logo)
   - `0x00C5`: LOAD resId=0x0047 -- Bitmap screen (credits art)
   - `0x00EA`: LOAD resId=0x0053 -- Alternate bitmap (if protection not passed)
   - `0x00F6`: LOAD resId=0x0013 -- Standard bitmap (if protection passed)
   - **`0x01A9`: LOAD GAME_PART(1)** -- Transition to intro (the critical one)
   - `0x0D1E`: LOAD GAME_PART(1) -- Dead code (never reached, follows a jmp)

3. **Protection check location**: 0x0C2A-0x0CB4 (the actual symbol matching)

4. **Transition to Part 1**: Two paths both end at `jmp 0x007F` (splash screens) which terminates with `LOAD GAME_PART(1)` at 0x01A9. The successful protection path goes 0x0CB7 -> 0x0CD3 (jmp 0x02D1) -> second pass -> 0x0CD7 -> 0x0D1B (jmp 0x007F) -> splash -> 0x01A9 LOAD GAME_PART(1).

file.content:
JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_PLAY_SOUND
	; Implement-me!
	; Note: We currently do not understand the Technics KN5000 sound hardware.
	ADD XIX, 5		; word resourceId; byte freq; byte vol; byte channel (INC only supports 1,2,4,8)
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_PLAY_SOUND:


	; ====  LOAD instruction  ====
	CP A, 19h
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_LOAD
	LD WA, (XIX)	; uint16_t resourceId = fetch_word()
	EX W, A			; byte-swap: bytecode is big-endian
	INC 2, XIX

	; resourceId == 0: stop sound (no-op, we don't have sound)
	CP WA, 0
	JP EQ, _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION

	; resourceId > 0x91: part switch request
	CP WA, NUM_MEM_LIST
	JP ULE, _load_check_screen
	LD (REQUESTED_NEXT_PART), WA
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION

_load_check_screen:
	; Check if resourceId matches a known screen bitmap resource
	; screen_resource_indexes = {0x49, 0x53} (available resources)
	CP WA, 049h
	JP NE, _load_not_0x49
	LD XHL, SCREEN_BITMAP_0x49
	CALL LOAD_SCREEN
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
_load_not_0x49:
	CP WA, 053h
	JP NE, _load_unknown
	LD XHL, SCREEN_BITMAP_0x53
	CALL LOAD_SCREEN
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
_load_unknown:
	; Unknown resource - ignore
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_LOAD:


	; ====  PLAY_MUSIC instruction  ====
	CP A, 1Ah
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_PLAY_MUSIC
	; Implement-me!
	; Note: We currently do not understand the Technics KN5000 sound hardware.
	ADD XIX, 5		; word resNum; word delay; byte pos (INC only supports 1,2,4,8)
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_PLAY_MUSIC:

		
_end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION:
	SUB XIX, (CUR_BYTECODE)
	LD (VM_PC), IX
_after_PC_update:
	POP XIY

The game_data/MSDOS directory has all resources from 0x00 to 0x91, including 0x12, 0x13, and 0x47. We need to extract these and include them.

But wait, there's a more important design question. The Part 0 splash screens use `LOAD resId=0x0012` (opcode 0x19) to load bitmap resources dynamically. In the original game, this opcode loads the resource data into memory from disk. In our VM, we have the LOAD opcode but it only handles:
1. Part switches (resId > 0x91)


2. Screen bitmaps 0x49 and 0x53
3. Everything else is ignored

To support the Part 0 splash screens, I'd need to extract resources 0x12, 0x13, and 0x47 from the game data, embed them in the ROM, and handle them in the LOAD opcode like we do for 0x49 and 0x53. The problem is these are screen bitmaps at 32000 bytes each (320x200 @ 4bpp), so embedding them directly would bloat the ROM significantly.

I'm realizing the splash screen code uses VIDEO 0x80 opcodes to draw from video2, but Part 0 doesn't have video2 available. The offsets like 0x1107C and 0x11058 in those VIDEO_0x80 instructions must point into a loaded bitmap resource instead. When the splash screens execute LOAD with a resource ID like 0x12, that bitmap data gets loaded into memory, and then the VIDEO_0x80 opcodes draw from that loaded data.

So the sequence is: LOAD replaces the video2 buffer with the resource data, then VIDEO_0x80 reads polygon or bitmap information from that buffer. In our implementation, CUR_VIDEO_2 would need to point to the loaded resource data after a LOAD instruction. I should check the reference implementation in the MAME driver to see exactly how LOAD handles non-part resources.

Looking at the original AW engine, LOAD works differently depending on the resource ID range. For IDs below GAME_PART (0x00-0x91), it looks up the resource in memlist and loads it based on type—cinematic polygons go to the video buffer, while screen bitmaps go to the screen buffer. Resources like 0x12 and 0x13 (the Delphine logo and credits screens) are screen bitmaps that get loaded this way, similar to resources 0x49 and 0x53. I need to check the memlist to confirm the types for these specific resources.

; (c) 2024 Felipe Correa da Silva Sanches <juca@members.fsf.org>
; Licensed under GPL version 2 or later.
;
; This is a port of the Another World VM (initially supporting only non-interactive
; playback of the game intro) to run from an extension board on a
; Technics SX-KN5000 musical keyboard.
;
; This program must replace the hd-ae5000_v2_01i.ic4 ROM of the extension board.
;
; This implementation is derived from my port of the Another World VM
; as a high-level emulation on MAME
;
; And that port was derived from Fabien Sanglard's AW-VM available at:
; https://github.com/fabiensanglard/Another-World-Bytecode-Interpreter
;
; The assembler I am using is compiled from source-code downloaded from
; http://john.ccac.rwth-aachen.de:8000/as/index.html
;
; Game assets must be extracted from an original copy of the game
; using the scripts provided at:
; https://github.com/felipesanches/AnotherWorld_VMTools
;
; === EQU Constants (shared) ===
PC_OFFSET			EQU 0  ; 16 bits
REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET	EQU 2  ; 16 bits
INACTIVE_THREAD		EQU 0FFFFh
DELETE_THIS_THREAD	EQU 0FFFEh
NO_REQUEST 			EQU 0FFFFh
TICKS_PER_SLICE		EQU 250		; ~20ms at 12500 Hz tick rate (80 µs/tick)

CURRENT_STATE	EQU 0  ; boolean stored as a byte
REQUESTED_STATE	EQU 1  ; boolean stored as a byte

FROZEN	EQU 0
NOT_FROZEN EQU 1
NO_STATE_REQUEST EQU 0FFh

; These off-screen video pages are stored in external RAM:
; MAINCPU: in DRAM at 0x020000-0x05FFFF
; EXTENSION: in extension board SRAM at 0x240000-0x27FFFF
	ifdef TARGET_MAINCPU
PAGE_BITMAP_0 EQU 020000h
PAGE_BITMAP_1 EQU 030000h
PAGE_BITMAP_2 EQU 040000h
PAGE_BITMAP_3 EQU 050000h
	endif
	ifdef TARGET_EXTENSION
PAGE_BITMAP_0 EQU 240000h
PAGE_BITMAP_1 EQU 250000h
PAGE_BITMAP_2 EQU 260000h
PAGE_BITMAP_3 EQU 270000h
	endif

; VM variable indices (used by the game engine)
VM_VARIABLE_RANDOM_SEED		EQU 03Ch
VM_VARIABLE_LAST_KEYCHAR	EQU 0C5h
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_UP_DOWN	EQU 0E5h
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_JUMP_DOWN	EQU 0DCh
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_LEFT_RIGHT	EQU 0E9h
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_MASK	EQU 0FAh
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_ACTION		EQU 0FBh
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_ACTION_POS_MASK EQU 0FBh
VM_VARIABLE_SCROLL_Y		EQU 0F9h

; Game part IDs (from reference: parts.h)
GAME_PART_FIRST			EQU 03E80h
GAME_PART_PROTECTION	EQU 03E80h	; Part 0: Copy protection
GAME_PART_INTRO			EQU 03E81h	; Part 1: Introduction cinematic
GAME_PART_WATER			EQU 03E82h	; Part 2: Water / lake
GAME_PART_JAIL			EQU 03E83h	; Part 3: Jail / prison
GAME_PART_CITADEL		EQU 03E84h	; Part 4: Citadel
GAME_PART_BATTLECHAR	EQU 03E85h	; Part 5: Battle cinematic
GAME_PART_ARENA			EQU 03E86h	; Part 6: Arena
GAME_PART_FINAL			EQU 03E87h	; Part 7: Final / ending
GAME_PART_PASSWORD1		EQU 03E88h	; Part 8: Password entry
GAME_PART_PASSWORD2		EQU 03E89h	; Part 9: Password entry (alt)
GAME_PART_LAST			EQU 03E89h
GAME_NUM_PARTS			EQU 10
NUM_MEM_LIST			EQU 091h

CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN:
	; int16_t xmax = MAX(x1, x2);
	LD WA, (X1)
	CP WA, (X2)
	JP GT, XMAX_OK
	LD WA, (X2)
XMAX_OK:
	LD (LINE_XMAX), WA
	
	; int16_t xmin = MIN(x1, x2);
	LD WA, (X1)
	CP WA, (X2)
	JP LT, XMIN_OK
	LD WA, (X2)
XMIN_OK:
	LD (LINE_XMIN), WA
	RET

LD XIX, (CUR_VIDEO_DATA)
	ADD XIX, XWA

	; B = color (0xFF = BLACK), zoom in CUR_ZOOM
	LD B, 0FFh

	; DE = x, HL = y, B = color, XIX = data pointer, CUR_ZOOM = zoom
	CALL readAndDrawPolygon

	; Reset video data pointer to default (VIDEO_1)
	PUSH XWA
	LD XWA, (CUR_VIDEO_1)
	LD (CUR_VIDEO_DATA), XWA
	POP XWA

	JP _after_PC_update

OPCODE_BIT_6_NOT_SET:


	; ====  MOV CONST instruction  ====
	CP A, 0
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_MOVCONST
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t variableId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	; Calculate destination pointer first
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA

; EXTENSION: Uses 512KB extension board SRAM at 0x200000-0x27FFFF

	ORG 010000h
	endif
	ifdef TARGET_EXTENSION
	ORG 0200000h

VM_VARIABLES:	DW	256 DUP (?)

THREADS_DATA:	DW	64*2 DUP (?)  ; For each of the 64 threads:

VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE:	DB	64*2 DUP (?)   ; For each of the 64 threads:

CURRENT_THREAD: DB ?
VM_PC:				DW ?
VM_STACK_POINTER: DD ?

POLYGON_NUM_POINTS:	DB ?
POLYGON_BBOX_W:		DW ?					; uint16_t
POLYGON_BBOX_H:		DW ?					; uint16_t
POLYGON_POINTS:		DW	50 DUP (?, ?, ?)

POLYGON_YMIN:	DW ?						; int16_t

CPT1_LOW:	DW ?

CPT2_HIGH:	DW ?

STEP2_LOW:	DW ?
STEP2_HIGH:	DW ?

X2:			DW ?

POLYGON_H:	DW ?
DX:			DW ?	; int16_t

LINE_XMIN:	DW ?
LINE_XMAX:	DW ?
CUR_PAGE_PTR_1: DD ?
CUR_PAGE_PTR_2: DD ?
CUR_PAGE_PTR_3: DD ?
CUR_VIDEO_DATA: DD ?			; Pointer to current video polygon data (video1 or video2)

; =============================================================================
; Main CPU ROM Layout
; =============================================================================
	ifdef TARGET_MAINCPU

STACK_TOP		EQU 001000h	; Stack in internal RAM
OFFSCREEN_BUFFER_1	EQU 060000h	; Offscreen buffer (required by vga_init, in DRAM)

	ORG 0E00000h

; Fill with 0xFF until code section
	rept 0F0000h		; ~960KB of padding
	db 0FFh
	endm

	ORG 0EF0000h

; Jump to Reset_Handler (VGA code is included first for macro definitions)
	jp Reset_Handler

; Include shared VGA I/O and initialization routines
	include "vga_io.asm"
	include "vga_init.asm"
	ret			; VGA_Setup has no ret (designed for inline use)

; Entry Point - Called after hardware reset
Reset_Handler:
	include "boot_hw_init.asm"

	; Set up stack pointer (after hardware init)
	LDA_XWA_IMM24 STACK_TOP
	ld XSP, XWA

	; Initialize VGA display using shared code
	CALR VGA_Setup

	; Turn screen on (sequencer clocking mode)
	VGA_SEQUENCER 01h, 001h

	jp ENTRY

	endif ; TARGET_MAINCPU

; =============================================================================
; Extension Board ROM Layout
; =============================================================================
	ifdef TARGET_EXTENSION

	ORG 0280000h

EXTENSION_HEADER:
	db 'XAPR'
	dd POINTERS
	JP ENTRY
POINTERS:
	db 0Eh, 00h, 00h, 00h; EMPTY_ROUTINE
	db 0Eh, 00h, 00h, 00h; EMPTY_ROUTINE
	db 0Eh, 00h, 00h, 00h; EMPTY_ROUTINE
	db 0Eh, 00h, 00h, 00h; EMPTY_ROUTINE
	db 0Eh, 00h, 00h, 00h; EMPTY_ROUTINE

	endif ; TARGET_EXTENSION

; =============================================================================
; VM Code (shared between both targets)
; =============================================================================
	include "another_world_vm.asm"

; =============================================================================
; ROM End (target-specific)
; =============================================================================
	ifdef TARGET_MAINCPU

INTT1_Handler:
	PUSH XWA
	LD XWA, (SYSTEM_TICKS)
	INC 1, XWA
	LD (SYSTEM_TICKS), XWA
	POP XWA
	RETI

Default_Handler:
	halt
	jr Default_Handler

; Reset Handler Location
	ORG 0FFFEE0h
Reset_Entry:
	jp Reset_Handler

; Fill gap between reset entry and vector table
	ORG 0FFFEE4h
	rept 01Ch
	db 0FFh
	endm

; Interrupt Vector Table
	ORG 0FFFF00h
VECTOR_TABLE:
	dd 00FFFEE0h		; Vector 0: Reset
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 1
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 2
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 3
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 4
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 5
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 6
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 7

	rept 13				; Entries 8-20 (offsets 0x20-0x50)
	dd Default_Handler
	endm
	dd INTT1_Handler		; Entry 21 (offset 0x54): INTT1
	rept 42				; Entries 22-63 (offsets 0x58-0xFC)
	dd Default_Handler
	endm

	endif ; TARGET_MAINCPU

	ifdef TARGET_EXTENSION

	ORG 02FFFFFh
	db 0FFh

	endif ; TARGET_EXTENSION

; =============================================================================
; End of ROM
; =============================================================================
	end

input.new_string:
LOAD_SCREEN:
; Input: XHL = pointer to 32000 bytes of 4bpp Amiga planar screen data
; Converts to 8bpp chunky and writes 64000 bytes to PAGE_BITMAP_0
; Planar format: 4 bitplanes x 8000 bytes (320x200 / 8 bits per byte)
; Each source byte produces 8 destination pixels.
; Clobbers: XWA, XBC, XDE, XHL; preserves XIX
	PUSH XIX

	LD (BMP_SRC_PTR), XHL		; save source base pointer
	LD XDE, PAGE_BITMAP_0		; destination: page 0 buffer
	LD IX, 8000					; outer loop: 8000 byte positions

_bmp_outer:
	; Load one byte from each of the 4 bitplanes
	LD XHL, (BMP_SRC_PTR)
	LD A, (XHL)					; plane 0 (bit 0 of pixel color)
	PUSH XHL
	ADD XHL, 8000
	LD B, (XHL)					; plane 1 (bit 1)
	ADD XHL, 8000
	LD C, (XHL)					; plane 2 (bit 2)
	ADD XHL, 8000
	LD W, (XHL)					; plane 3 (bit 3)
	POP XHL
	INC XHL
	LD (BMP_SRC_PTR), XHL		; advance source pointer

	; Convert 8 pixels from MSB to LSB
	; A=plane0, B=plane1, C=plane2, W=plane3
	LD H, 8						; pixel counter (8 pixels per byte)
_bmp_pixel:
	LD L, 0
	; Extract MSB from each plane (p3 first → bit 3 of pixel)
	SLA 1, W					; plane 3 MSB → carry
	RLC L						; carry → L bit 0
	SLA 1, C					; plane 2 MSB → carry
	RLC L						; carry → L bit 0, prev → bit 1
	SLA 1, B					; plane 1 MSB → carry
	RLC L						; carry → L bit 0
	SLA 1, A					; plane 0 MSB → carry
	RLC L						; L = (p3<<3)|(p2<<2)|(p1<<1)|p0
	LD (XDE), L
	INC XDE
	DJNZ H, _bmp_pixel

	DJNZ IX, _bmp_outer

	POP XIX
	RET
